{{Top}}
A '''watt''' was a measurement unit of power. The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ships]] had a [[Reactor/Legends|main reactor]] power output of 2x10<sup>23</sup> watts and a peak [[Deflector shield/Legends|shielding]] power of 7x10<sup>22</sup> watts.
